description: Repairs r-sort-3b/image-failed-unique: the TableDefs collection was not refreshed after CREATE TABLE, so TableDefs.Item("TU") failed (0x800A0CC1) and the metadata of TU was never read; refused unique builds, inserts and updates ran with no options so their error numbers were not captured; and the intermediate images were size-only (file in use). New General ACCDB. T(ID Long primary key, K TEXT(40)) with the first 10 pair-corpus values (a, A, b, B, e, E, e-acute, E-acute, e-grave, e + combining acute), image kept. Each of these steps is its own read/write open of the closed file with dbFailOnError, DBEngine.Errors after the statement and an image kept after the close: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_K ON T (K) (equal-comparing values are present); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_KID ON T (K, ID); CREATE TABLE TU with unique index UX on K and the rows a and b; INSERT of A; UPDATE of b to A; INSERT of a Null; INSERT of a second Null. Then, through a read-only open: the refreshed index metadata of T and TU, a UX_K walk of T (does a refused build leave a trace), the IDs of TU, and the UX walk of TU. Asks what a refused unique build, insert and update leave in the file and in the index list, and which rows the unique index admits.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
